question: List the three mandatory safety pre-conditions before hot-swapping a failed U.2 NVMe bay.
ground_truth_answer: Engineers must: (1) confirm the fault LED is solid amber (never pull blinking green I/O), (2) run nvme list and lsblk -o NAME,SERIAL,STATE via SSH to confirm namespace detachment and match the serial number, and (3) ensure chassis ambient inlet temp is <= 35C.

Confirm chassis ambient inlet temperature remains at or below 35C during single-fan maintenance windows.
